hook.text: A phone is useless if nobody else has one. More users make each user's experience more valuable.

buildup.text: This is a network effect: the value of a product increases with the number of people using it.

discovery.text: Facebook, Uber, and Airbnb all leveraged network effects to dominate their markets.

twist.text: Network effects create winner-take-all dynamics. Second place often means irrelevance.

climax.text: Once a platform reaches critical mass, the network itself becomes the moat that competitors can't cross.

punchline.text: More users make more users join.

quiz.question: What is a network effect?
options: A product becomes more valuable as more people use it
